title: Unbounded proper coefficient comparison and restricted projection identity
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-asd-proper-finite-coefficient-extension, for every unbounded derived input L the canonical scalar mate is an isomorphism, and its restriction of scalars agrees with the ordered proper projection morphism after the canonical scalar/tensor, pullback and direct-image comparisons.

source.place: Tag 0GL6, proper case; Tags 0B56 and 0D6E for the counit mate and direct-image comparison.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution with flat terms for the input. The canonical derived scalar/tensor comparison, inverse-image tensor pullback comparison and restriction/direct-image mate are represented termwise on this resolution and descend to the unbounded derived category.

After restriction of scalars, the mate is the ordered coefficient-first projection morphism. The proper finite-coefficient projection theorem makes this composite an isomorphism for every input; exact restriction is conservative, so the scalar mate itself is an isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0GL6 proper coefficient comparison, expanded with Tags 0B56 and 0D6E.
